tests.title: Our OCS has the course, its transit area, and a fence UAV1 holds
tests.note: ALPHA: 5 corners + uav_transit_area 5 points -> fence 5 points (course + transit area inset 2.0 m); UAV1 read it back 0.5 s ago, matches: True; reporting: USV1, UUV1, UAV1
tests.doing: Our OCS on the laptop takes Course Alpha from this broker, works out the UAV fence over course + transit area and tells UAV1, which reads it back. USV1 (the boat's own ocs_link.py), UAV1 and GRAEY UUV1 start heartbeating through our OCS.
tests.expect: Judged on the laptop from our OCS's state, the evidence posted here. On this page: first heartbeats from ASTA/USV1, UAV1 and UUV1.

tests.title: No pilot call sign: our OCS refuses, RoboCommand hears nothing
tests.doing: Pressing Declare on our OCS with the call-sign box empty.
tests.expect: Our OCS's refusal, in words, as a note -- and no REQUEST card from ASTA.

tests.title: With a call sign, RoboCommand accepts the fence and starts the run
tests.doing: Declaring again with call sign E2EPILOT-0000: USV1 + UAV1 + UUV1, the stand-in pilot's fence read off UAV1 (inside the course fence), ceiling 39 m HAE (home 9 + FENCE_ALT_MAX 30).
tests.expect: A blue REQUEST card from ASTA with the call sign and ceiling, the server's 'geofence and ceiling OK', then a green COMMAND run_start for ASTA.

tests.title: Our OCS knows the run started
tests.note: run state RUNNING, run_id 1, declaration seq 1, declared USV1, UUV1, UAV1
tests.doing: Reading our OCS's run state after that RunStart.
tests.expect: RUNNING, with RoboCommand's run id. Judged on the laptop.

tests.title: All three heartbeats reach RoboCommand at 2 Hz through our OCS
tests.doing: USV1, UAV1 and UUV1 keep heartbeating; our OCS re-stamps and publishes each one.
tests.expect: ASTA/USV1, ASTA/UAV1 and ASTA/UUV1 in the Heartbeats table at about 2 Hz. Heartbeats never become cards.

tests.title: A task report from the boat reaches RoboCommand
tests.doing: USV1 sends one Task 3 DockingReport (bay 2) on the boat's ocs_link.py, among the heartbeats.
tests.expect: One big amber TASK REPORT card from ASTA/USV1.

tests.title: Our OCS shows that report acknowledged
tests.note: USV1 docking ACKNOWLEDGED: seq=20, RoboCommand's broker acknowledged it (PUBACK)
tests.doing: Reading the 'Task reports to RoboCommand' card on our OCS.
tests.expect: The docking report ACKNOWLEDGED: this broker returned its PUBACK (QoS 1). Judged on the laptop.

tests.title: RoboCommand sends a MovingObjectAlert with a 7 m keep-out
tests.doing: RoboNation's test_client, as RoboCommand, alerts ASTA to a moving object at the course centre with keep_out_radius_m = 7.
tests.expect: A green COMMAND card for ASTA with keep_out_radius_m = 7.

tests.title: The alert reaches all three vehicles, radius intact
tests.doing: Looking at the OCS routing and all three production-link receive callbacks.
tests.expect: USV1, UAV1 and UUV1 got moving_object_alert with keep_out_radius_m = 7.

tests.title: Submerged GRAEY retains its survey
tests.doing: Queueing a synthetic survey through GRAEY's production durable outbox at 2 m depth.
tests.expect: One pending report, no pipeline survey on RoboCommand's broker for six seconds.

tests.title: GRAEY reconnects, surfaces and delivers the queued survey
tests.doing: Dropping only the fixture socket, then setting simulated surfaced status.
tests.expect: The actual client reconnects, receives current run context and reports intact/damaged/intact.

tests.title: Broker acknowledgement returns to GRAEY's outbox
tests.doing: Checking the actual sender's receipt handling and second TCP connection.
tests.expect: One acknowledged report, zero pending; this is a PUBACK, not a scoring verdict.

tests.title: End run reaches GRAEY
tests.note: run ended; GRAEY remote state=ENDED, confirmed=False
tests.doing: Ending the isolated shared OCS run with the same API used by its GUI.
tests.expect: GRAEY sees ENDED and clears run confirmation.
